findings.subject: ApiGatewayApplication#loadBalancedRestTemplate:new RestTemplate()
findings.message: new RestTemplate() uses SimpleClientHttpRequestFactory with no connect or read timeout (infinite).
findings.why: A call without a read timeout waits as long as the remote side keeps the socket open. When a dependency hangs, request threads pile up on it until the service stops responding: one slow dependency becomes a full outage.
findings.fix: Build it with RestTemplateBuilder.connectTimeout(...).readTimeout(...), or pass a request factory with timeouts set.

findings.subject: AIDataProvider#AIDataProvider:RestClient.builder
findings.message: RestClient.builder()...build() sets no request factory, so no explicit timeouts apply (Spring Boot properties only configure the injected builder).
findings.why: A call without a read timeout waits as long as the remote side keeps the socket open. When a dependency hangs, request threads pile up on it until the service stops responding: one slow dependency becomes a full outage.
findings.fix: Add .requestFactory(factory) with connect and read timeouts, or inject the auto-configured RestClient.Builder.
